instructions: Each phase must include target files, allowed changes, forbidden changes, acceptance criteria, and validation commands.
Separate business logic, UI, state management, and Firebase integration responsibilities clearly.
Do not modify files outside the phase scope.
Follow frontend_rules.md for TypeScript, Composition API, Pinia, loading, API, and SCSS rules.

documents.description: Primary review checklist for frontend rule compliance.
Global AI workflow and architecture constraints.
Project-specific Phaseharness context, plan, generate, and evaluate rules.

rules: Apply a loading hook or explicit loading state for API or Firebase async calls.
Use try/catch/finally for API or Firebase async calls.
Use script setup only in Vue files.
Use SCSS only for Vue styles.
Do not mutate Pinia state directly; enforce action-based updates.
Separate UI logic from business logic.
Preserve the existing project structure and shared component reuse policy.
For large feature work, leave clarify, context-gather, plan, generate, and evaluate workflow artifacts.
